source_caption:
Swiss Dot is finally here!!

We've just added Premium Swiss Dot to our factory's fabric options, and I can't wait to see all the pretty little dresses we'll make with it!

I absolutely love the tiny raised dots and that soft, vintage look. Just imagine this with hand smocking, delicate embroidery, or some cute little bows!

And if you've been wanting to try something different for your brand, we can help you play around with the design, choose the right details, and even create a Free 2D mockup so you can see how everything looks together before production

You don't need to have everything figured out. Even a reference photo or a little idea is enough for us to start exploring!

K-Embroidery offers 𝗮𝗹𝗹-𝗶𝗻-𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝘂𝗳𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 for your brand:
• FREE 2D mock-up design service with diverse design options
• 100% hand smocking & hand embroidery by Vietnamese artisans
• Direct production from our factory
• Low MOQs & flexible for your first order
• Sample development & bulk production
• Worldwide shipping via FedEx/UPS

Anyone thinking of using Swiss Dot for their next collection? I'd love to hear your ideas!
